prompt: In Chiang Mai, chef Mali gave (every / all) guest a small (jar / peanuts).
explanation_ru: Перед исчисляемым существительным в единственном числе (guest) ставится every, а не all. Для ёмкости с содержимым нужен предлог of: a jar of peanuts.

prompt: Did we buy (some / any) tape to go with these two (tins / paint)?
explanation_ru: В обычном вопросе о наличии чего-либо используется any, а для указания количества краски в банках — конструкция с предлогом of (two tins of paint).

prompt: At the Manchester cinema, the surprised man dropped ___ sweet popcorn near the door.
explanation_ru: С одним исчисляемым предметом (a/the tub) используется the whole, а не all the. Частая ошибка — переводить «весь стакан» дословно как all the tub или ставить whole перед the.

prompt: For their school science project, (both / either) cousins brought a (bottle / vinegar).
explanation_ru: После both существительное стоит во множественном числе (both cousins), тогда как either требует единственного числа. Бутылка уксуса — a bottle of vinegar.

prompt: Our narrow shoe rack has not got no space left for my winter boots.
answer: Our narrow shoe rack has not got any space left for my winter boots.
accepted_answers: Our narrow shoe rack has not got any space left for my winter boots.
Our narrow shoe rack hasn't got any space left for my winter boots.
Our narrow shoe rack has got no space left for my winter boots.
explanation_ru: В английском предложении не допускается двойное отрицание (has not got no). После отрицательного глагола используется any, либо утвердительный глагол с no.

prompt: We packed two (loaves / bread) and some jam before driving to the lake.
explanation_ru: Неисчисляемое существительное bread считают буханками через предлог of: two loaves of bread.

prompt: Henri looked inside his jam jar in the fridge, but there was ___ left.
explanation_ru: Когда существительное не повторяется после определителя, вместо no используется самостоятельное местоимение none. Частая ошибка — оставить no без существительного.

prompt: Have we packed (enough / sandwiches) and two hot (flasks / tea) for the walk?
explanation_ru: Слово enough всегда ставится перед существительным (enough sandwiches), а термос с чаем передаётся конструкцией flasks of tea.

prompt: Sam bought two cold drinks at the Liverpool cinema, tripped on his shoelace, and spilled both cups on the floor. Which sentence fits?
options: None of the two drinks reached his seat.
Both drinks did not reach his seat.
explanation_ru: Для отрицания обоих из двух предметов используется neither + существительное в единственном числе (Neither drink). Варианты с none of the two и both ... not неестественны.

prompt: Gerry did not notice any mistakes before sending his shopping list to the group. → Gerry noticed …
answer: Gerry noticed no mistakes before sending his shopping list to the group.
accepted_answers: Gerry noticed no mistakes before sending his shopping list to the group.
explanation_ru: Конструкцию с отрицательным глаголом и any (did not notice any) можно заменить на утвердительный глагол с no (noticed no).

prompt: The beach looks quiet and sunny today! I made two big (jugs / lemonade) for our picnic. Could you bring (some / no) peaches from the kitchen table?
explanation_ru: Кувшины с лимонадом оформляются с предлогом of (jugs of lemonade), а в вежливой просьбе (Could you bring...?) вместо any и no используется some.

prompt: Almost the (all / whole) village signed the photo book and brought a large (basket / cheese) for the retiring clerk.
explanation_ru: После артикля the перед исчисляемым существительным в единственном числе (village) ставится whole, а не all. Корзина сыра — a basket of cheese.

prompt: After spotting two fake coins at her stall, Amparo warned every nearby seller that each coin (need) a careful look.
explanation_ru: После each + существительное в единственном числе (each coin) глагол всегда стоит в единственном числе (needs).

prompt: Because loose bread crumbs float in space, astronauts drink each (tube / juice) carefully and cannot leave (any / no) crumbs behind.
explanation_ru: Тюбик сока передаётся через of (tube of juice). Поскольку в глаголе cannot уже есть отрицание, далее используется any, а не no.

prompt: Barry complained that his large bowl did not have (enough / peas) and that his (mug / tea) was completely cold.
explanation_ru: Слово enough ставится перед существительным (enough peas), а кружка чая оформляется с предлогом of (mug of tea).

prompt: Five waiters walked past our retirement table in Merida, yet ___ of them noticed we had only three spoons.
explanation_ru: Официантов пятеро (больше двух), поэтому вместо neither нужно none of them. Варианты no of и every of грамматически невозможны.

prompt: Amelie wrote clear steps on the small box of eye drops. Wash (both / either) hands carefully before you open the cap. Use two (drops / liquid) in the evening and never touch the tip. Keep the bottle in a cool, dry cupboard.
explanation_ru: Перед существительным во множественном числе (hands) используется both, а не either; количество капель жидкости выражается через of (drops of liquid).

prompt: The first candidate did not know where to store the clay pots, and the second candidate did not know either. → Neither of …
answer: Neither of the candidates knew where to store the clay pots.
accepted_answers: Neither of the candidates knew where to store the clay pots.
Neither of the two candidates knew where to store the clay pots.
explanation_ru: Конструкция Neither of сама по себе отрицательна, поэтому глагол после неё стоит в утвердительной форме (knew, а не didn't know).

prompt: In the Florence painting class, each of the eight beginners have a thick sheet of paper and three soft brushes.
answer: In the Florence painting class, each of the eight beginners has a thick sheet of paper and three soft brushes.
accepted_answers: In the Florence painting class, each of the eight beginners has a thick sheet of paper and three soft brushes.
explanation_ru: Конструкция each of + существительное во множественном числе согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе: has, а не have.

prompt: Are you ready to catch the train to Roskilde? I checked our rucksacks, and (neither / none) of us remembered to pack dry socks! At least we still have three big (litres / water) and our raincoats. Let's buy socks near the station.
explanation_ru: Друзей двое, поэтому используется neither of us, а не none of us; мера объёма воды оформляется с предлогом of (litres of water).

prompt: Please wrap ___ fragile paint jar in soft paper before sticking the free yellow return label on the box.
explanation_ru: Существительное jar стоит в единственном числе, поэтому подходит только each. Слова all, both и most требуют множественного числа (jars).

prompt: Coach Hannah's poolside notice warns that (neither / none) of the parents may carry glass bottles onto the wet tiles.
explanation_ru: Объявление адресовано всем родителям в бассейне (их больше двух), поэтому требуется none of the parents, а не neither.

prompt: Rain started dripping right beside the coffee bar in our Turin office. Lorenzo grabbed three empty soup pots and a thick (stack / towels) from the cupboard. Each of the pots (be) filling up slowly while we wait for the plumber. Nobody dares to plug the kettle in.
explanation_ru: Стопка полотенец передаётся через of (a stack of towels), а подлежащее Each of the pots требует глагола в единственном числе (is).

prompt: Before the Siena craft class began, (each / every) of the eight newcomers received thick gloves and a small (tin / glue).
explanation_ru: Перед предлогом of используется each (each of the eight newcomers), тогда как every of не существует. Банка клея — a tin of glue.

prompt: — Celine, why are you rushing out of the Strasbourg office before nine? — Twenty summer interns are arriving soon, and only fifteen welcome bags are ready. Every intern (expect) a notebook and a small (pack / pens) on their desk. I have to run to the shop across the street!
explanation_ru: После every + существительное в единственном числе глагол всегда стоит в единственном числе (expects); упаковка ручек — a pack of pens.

prompt: Because the desert camp in Jordan lies far from town, Layla orders ten (jugs / water) whenever each of the supply trucks (head) back to the main road.
explanation_ru: Десять кувшинов воды оформляются с предлогом of (ten jugs of water), а конструкция each of the supply trucks требует глагола в единственном числе (heads).

prompt: Whenever Theo and his five friends cycle up the steep valley near Chambery, they stop at a stone fountain where every one of the riders (rest) and shares a (slice / cake).
explanation_ru: Подлежащее every one of the riders согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе (rests), а кусок пирога передаётся партитивной конструкцией a slice of cake.

prompt: Outside the Reykjavik security desk, an airport officer pointed to a large poster explaining that every passenger must place small bottles of liquid inside one clear plastic bag.
answer: Outside the Reykjavik security desk, an airport officer pointed to a large poster explaining that every passenger must place small bottles of liquid inside one clear plastic bag.
accepted_answers: Outside the Reykjavik security desk, an airport officer pointed to a large poster explaining that every passenger must place small bottles of liquid inside one clear plastic bag.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: every верно употреблено с существительным в единственном числе (passenger), а конструкция bottles of liquid построена правильно.

prompt: Since Petra put up colour-coded signs at the Munich recycling centre, ___ of the Saturday visitors knows exactly where to drop glass jars and cardboard.
explanation_ru: Глагол knows стоит в единственном числе, а перед of нельзя поставить every. Единственный верный вариант — each (each of the Saturday visitors knows).

prompt: Jonas decided to make strawberry jam for the first time in his Oslo flat. He washed two (bowls / strawberries) and stirred them slowly with sugar until the kitchen smelled wonderful. He tasted one (spoonful / jam) with a grin, checked that every single glass jar (be) completely dry, and poured the warm fruit carefully. By evening, five bright red jars stood proudly on the shelf.
explanation_ru: Ёмкости и меры количества требуют предлога of (bowls of strawberries, spoonful of jam), а подлежащее every single glass jar — глагола в единственном числе (was).

prompt: Although she accidentally spilled a whole carton of oat milk during her trial shift in Bern, every people in the morning queue praised how calmly she handled the mess.
answer: Although she accidentally spilled a whole carton of oat milk during her trial shift in Bern, everyone in the morning queue praised how calmly she handled the mess.
accepted_answers: Although she accidentally spilled a whole carton of oat milk during her trial shift in Bern, everyone in the morning queue praised how calmly she handled the mess.
Although she accidentally spilled a whole carton of oat milk during her trial shift in Bern, everybody in the morning queue praised how calmly she handled the mess.
Although she accidentally spilled a whole carton of oat milk during her trial shift in Bern, every person in the morning queue praised how calmly she handled the mess.
explanation_ru: Нельзя говорить every people, потому что every используется только с единственным числом. Правильно — everyone, everybody или every person.

prompt: My twelve-year-old twins are testing their homemade solar oven in the Regina school gym. They taped a bright (sheet / foil) inside a pizza box and set a tiny dish of butter in the middle. Neither twin (want) to blink in case the butter melts while they look away! Do you think it will actually work?
explanation_ru: Лист фольги выражается через of (a sheet of foil), а после neither + существительное в единственном числе (Neither twin) глагол стоит в единственном числе (wants).

prompt: While two hundred runners climbed the steep hill in Chamonix, Alice and Omar handed out (slices / orange) and warm (cups / soup) without taking a single break.
explanation_ru: Дольки фруктов и порции напитков или супа оформляются с предлогом of: slices of orange и cups of soup.

prompt: The village librarian in Tralee retired after many years driving the book van, and local readers spent the entire morning filling a giant basket with cakes and homemade jam. Which sentence is grammatically natural and accurate?
options: Local readers spent all the day packing a giant basket of cakes and homemade jam.
Local readers spent whole morning packing a giant basket of cakes and homemade jam.
Local readers spent the whole morning packing a giant basket of cakes and homemade jam.
Local readers spent every morning packing a giant basket of cakes and homemade jam.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения одного целого отрезка времени используется the whole morning (с артиклем the). Выражения all the day и whole morning без артикля ошибочны, а every morning меняет смысл.

prompt: — Who was the last person in our upstairs bathroom in Lublin? — Not me, why do you ask? — Someone used the last (drop / soap) from the pump and left four wet towels right in front of the door. Whenever this happens, nobody (admit) it! Could one of you pick up a fresh (bottle / shampoo) on the way home too?
explanation_ru: Неисчисляемые жидкости считают с помощью слов меры и предлога of (drop of soap, bottle of shampoo), а местоимение nobody всегда согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе (admits).
